plain: Below 640px, variables.css now carries the phone-width token values that only styles.css had, so a page that loads variables.css first no longer shifts when styles.css loads.

steps.plain: Below 640px, variables.css now sets this variable to its phone value (section stack 64px, was 96px), as styles.css already did, so a page that loaded variables.css first no longer shifts when styles.css loads.
